sources.caveat: Location and annual classification data are generally seasonal or annual.

sources.caveat: Samples are latest official results, not continuous live sensors.

sources.name: EPA Bathing Water alerts
sources.caveat: Alerts are current API records reported by local authorities to EPA.

sources.name: EPA WFD Open Data context
sources.caveat: WFD data describe catchment and waterbody status/context, not live water chemistry.

sources.name: EPA Geoportal water quality datasets
